"The issue of any delay on the part of the answering respondent is not the subject matter of the present petition. It would be pertinent to highlight the fact that despite the delay occasioned on account of reasons beyond the control of NTL, the said entity (NTL) has been successful in commissioning all the elements of project in tandem with the upstream 800 kV HVDC Champa- Kurukshetra bi-pole." 36.
